start: Owner on the Visits page, Register tab, day "Today"; a member with a running plan is at the desk

steps.action: Open "Visits" from the menu
user_sees: Title "Visits", line "Who trained, and when"
Tabs "Register" and "Losing the habit" (with a count)
Card "Check someone in" with the day chips "Today", "Yesterday", "Another day"
must_not: The Register opens on a past day
The count on "Losing the habit" differs from the list behind it

steps.action: Type the name or the last 4 digits of the mobile in "Name or last 4 digits of mobile"
user_sees: The matching member with the plan-state pill, a "₹… due" pill when money is owed, the mobile number and the batch
A button "Check in"
must_not: An expired plan or unpaid dues hide the "Check in" button
An archived member or a member of another gym in the results

steps.action: Tap "Check in"
user_sees: The button reads "Saving…"
A toast "<name> checked in."
The search box empties
The member appears under "In today"
"Check-ins today" goes up by one
must_not: Two visits for the same member on the same day
The toast shows but the visit is not saved
The visit saved on yesterday or tomorrow

steps.action: Read the tiles and the two charts below
user_sees: "Check-ins today" ("So far today")
"Visits in 30 days"
"Check-ins a day" (or "Check-ins a week" for a quiet gym)
"Busiest hour"
"Last 30 days" and "When the gym is busy"
must_not: A tile showing NaN or a minus figure
"Busiest hour" counting visits that carry no real time

start: Owner on the Visits Register; the desk forgot to mark a batch two days ago

steps.action: Tap the day chip "Another day" and pick the day in "Register date"
user_sees: The date box with the hint "Use this to add a day the desk missed. You can’t pick a future day."
A warning strip "Adding check-ins for <that day>"
must_not: The chip snaps back to "Today"
Check-ins still go to today while the strip names another day

steps.action: Tap a batch chip (shown only when the gym has batches)
user_sees: Every member of that batch, A to Z, each with "Check in" or "✓ Already in"
must_not: Rows jump as members are checked in
Members of other batches in the list

steps.action: Tap "Check in" on three members
user_sees: A toast for each: "<name> checked in."
The register below shows them on that day ("On that day")
must_not: The time of typing counted as the hour they trained
A member checked in on that day and also on today

steps.action: Type a name nobody has
user_sees: "Nobody matches that"
"Check the spelling, or add them in Members first." (a gym with branches also reads: A member of another branch? Use “Member from another branch” below.)
Button "Open Members"
must_not: A blank area with no words
A check-in made for the nearest name

steps.action: Tap "Another day" and type tomorrow's date
user_sees: Under the date: "That day hasn’t happened yet."
"Pick a day first" / "Pick a day that has already passed. Then the check-in box comes back."
The register reads "No day selected" / "Pick a day above to see who trained."
must_not: A visit saved on a future day
"Check-ins today" showing 0 for a busy gym while no day is picked

steps.action: Go back to "Today" and search a member who is already in
user_sees: "✓ Already in" in place of the button
must_not: A second visit for the same day

start: Owner on the Visits Register; a member was checked in by mistake today

steps.action: Find the member under "In today" and tap "Undo"
user_sees: A toast "Check-in removed for <name>."
The row leaves the register
"Check-ins today" goes down by one
must_not: The member's visits on other days are removed
Other members' visits of the same day are removed
The row comes back after the next sync

steps.action: Search the same member again
user_sees: The button "Check in" is back (not "✓ Already in")
must_not: The member stays marked as in

steps.action: Tap "Check in" again
user_sees: Toast "<name> checked in." and one row in the register
must_not: Two rows for the member

start: Owner on the Visits Register with a member who owes money

steps.action: Search the member
user_sees: The member's mobile number, plan state and "₹… due" on the row
must_not: Members of another gym or branch in the results
More personal data than name, mobile, batch, plan state and amount due

steps.action: Check the member in, then undo it
user_sees: The visit, then no visit; a workout or a challenge that needs "a check-in that day" follows the register
must_not: MettleUp staff seeing this member's name through the check-in
A visit kept on the server after the desk removed it
